reason: Imports Claude Code conversations into DSH sessions, loads CLAUDE.md and DSH.md context, and provides /init-based DSH.md generation; the README states that imported tool calls are not re-executed.

summaries.zh: 将 Claude Code 的对话和记忆文件导入 DSH，会话可回溯，并提供 /init 命令生成或改进 DSH.md。
summaries.en: Imports Claude Code conversations and memory files into DSH, preserving sessions for review while providing an /init command to create or improve DSH.md.

capabilities: Reads CLAUDE.md and DSH.md memory files and referenced imports
Generates or updates DSH.md through the /init command within the current workspace
Parses Claude Code JSONL conversation and subagent files
Persists imported sessions and attaches them to a workspace
Provides UI and model-tool entry points for listing and importing conversations
